name: Junia
description_en:
Junia creates and optimizes website articles from topics, keywords or competitor-page inputs, with brand context, linking and publishing integrations. Scale plans add content planning, bulk creation and scheduled AutoBlog publication. The workflow therefore includes a real website-write step, not only text generation.

The site promises search rankings and AI-assistant citations, but this profile establishes only described functionality. A generated article still needs original evidence, editorial review and an appropriate publishing policy; neither schema markup nor a visibility dashboard guarantees discovery or useful traffic.
description_zh:
Junia 根据主题、关键词或竞品页面生成及优化网站文章，结合品牌上下文、链接和发布集成。Scale 增加规划、批量创作及 AutoBlog 定时发布，因此包含真实网站写入，而非只有文字生成。

网站宣传排名与 AI 引用，本文只确认所述功能。文章仍需原创证据、编辑审核及发布规则，结构化标记或可见性仪表盘不保证被发现或得到有效流量。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate articles using topic and brand inputs, then review in the editor.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按主题及品牌输入生成文章，再在编辑器审核。

core_features.explanation_en: Scale includes AutoBlog scheduling, bulk generation and publishing integrations.
core_features.explanation_zh: Scale 包含 AutoBlog、批量生成及发布集成。

en: Prepare and source-check a product guide before a controlled CMS publication.
zh: 在受控 CMS 发布前准备并核实产品指南来源。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Connect a test site, generate one article from verified inputs, review it and inspect the actual published status before scheduling more.
steps.zh: 连接测试站、用已核输入生成一篇，审核并检查真实发布状态，再安排更多定时。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Article/credit subscription by editing versus automated-publishing tier; optional managed service.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed Growth $20/month/ten articles; Scale Starter $35/month/sixty-eight articles with billing selector unresolved and title mentioning $17. Monthly credit refresh/top-ups; free-plan allowance unknown. Separate managed service from $2,000/month. Confirm exact billing, currency, credits, failed runs and publishing scope.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Growth 展示月 $20/10 篇，Scale Starter 月 $35/68 篇，所选账期未定且标题提 $17。额度月刷可增购，免费额度未知，独立代运营起月 $2,000。需确认账期、币种、额度、失败及发布范围。

sources.title: AI SEO Writer That Ranks on Google & ChatGPT
sources.research_notes_en: SEO content planning, generation and scheduled publication; rankings and AI citations are unverified vendor claims.

sources.title: Junia AI Pricing: Affordable AI SEO Content Plans From $17/mo
sources.research_notes_en: Growth versus Scale feature/article allowances, displayed $20/$35 with selector ambiguity and title mismatch; monthly credit refresh and optional $2,000/month service.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_zh: 明确初稿、审核与发布顺序
sections.en: For an illustrative product guide, supply the real product constraints and sources, generate one article and verify claims, images, links and translated amounts before publishing. The site permits manual review instead of automatic publication. Inspect the actual CMS status and URL: successful generation does not prove the right page went live, and a competitor URL is research input rather than permission to copy.
sections.zh: 例如产品指南，应提供真实条件和来源，生成后核对主张、图片、链接及翻译金额再发布。官网允许手动审查代替自动发布，应检查 CMS 状态及 URL，生成成功不证明正确页面已上线，竞品 URL 也是研究输入而非复制许可。

sections.title_en: Separate self-directed writing from autopilot and services
sections.title_zh: 区分自行写作、自动发布与人工服务
sections.en: Growth lists ten SEO articles/month and editing/research/linking tools. Scale Starter lists sixty-eight monthly articles, scheduling, unlimited websites and API; higher Scale variants raise volume. Cards show $20/$35 per month next to billing controls, while the title mentions $17, so exact selected price and period need checkout confirmation. A separate done-for-you service starts $2,000/month and is not the software starting price.
sections.zh: Growth 列每月 10 篇及编辑/研究/链接工具；Scale Starter 列每月 68 篇、定时、不限网站和 API，更高 Scale 增量。账期选择旁卡片显示月 $20/$35，标题又提 $17，需结账确认具体价与周期。独立代运营起月 $2,000，不是软件起价。

sections.title_en: Check credits, connections and publication failures
sections.title_zh: 核对额度、连接和发布失败
sections.en: The FAQ says credits refresh monthly and extra credits can be purchased. Cancellation keeps access until the period ends; the free plan is offered for evaluation, but its allowance was not resolved. Confirm article versus credit definitions, failed-generation charges, image rights and CMS permissions. No connector, scheduled job, cancellation or retry was executed. Unlimited websites does not establish unlimited article volume or outside service costs.
sections.zh: FAQ 称额度月度刷新、可增购，取消后保留至期末；有免费评估方案，但未确定额度。需确认文章与额度定义、失败生成计费、图片权利及 CMS 权限。本文未执行连接、定时、取消或重试，不限网站不表示文章或外部费用不限。

sections.title_en: Judge content quality separately from SEO promises
sections.title_zh: 把内容质量与 SEO 宣传分开判断
sections.en: Junia merits investigation for teams preparing repeatable website drafts with a review owner. Automatic public publishing without a factual review is a different risk profile. Advertised ranking, citation, traffic and managed-service guarantee outcomes were not independently verified. No source license, self-hosted package, contract privacy terms or broad language-quality claim was established.
sections.zh: 有明确审核人的重复网站起草可研究 Junia，未经事实审核就自动公开发布有不同风险。排名、引用、流量及代运营效果保证均未独立验证。本次未确定源码许可、自托管、合同隐私或广泛语言质量。

research_gaps: No generation, CMS write, schedule, image rights, translation, ranking or AI citation outcome was tested.
Billing/title mismatch, free allowance, credit definitions/failure charges, data terms, license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
